ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of disobeying a knowledgeable and experienced advisor according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this passage from the 'After Arbitration' section of Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (AS) laments the rejection of his sincere counsel by the people of Kufa, attributing their regret to their stubbornness and deviation from the truth. He illustrates the consequence of ignoring a trusted, experienced advisor by quoting the poet Qays ibn al-Mulawwah, comparing his own situation to that of the Banu Hawazin after the Battle of Hunayn, where the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) was also initially rejected by his followers despite his guidance.
